content.value: Separation rule

items: OpenAI and ServiceNow are separate deliverables, not sections of one blended organization report.
OpenAI answers: what enterprise buyers are asking about OpenAI, including market-specific cuts.
ServiceNow answers: what commercial and economic friction buyers are raising about ServiceNow.
The shared methodology explains how both outcomes are produced from GEAR data, prompts, evidence, ratings, and validation.

sections.title: Slides 9-14 Template - Method and Operating Model

content.value: Matches the methodology/process slides in the deck. These slides explain what Buyer Voice is, what decisions sit outside automation, and what the current pipeline can and cannot automate.

rows: Gartner end-user interactions become traceable analyst/client-ready slides.
One corpus can answer multiple asks through different prompt-layer scopes.
Ways to Look at the Data
Market, vendor, vendor-in-market, relationship, and absence views are distinct report anchors.
Mechanics can be trained; corpus boundaries, market boundaries, and evidence strength require practitioner judgment.
Formatter and search support exist; claim checking, slide building, and reusable pull definitions need automation.
GEAR retirement and source-system uncertainty affect future data acquisition.

content.value: Reusable anchor types

items: Market view: no vendor anchor; identify where demand is heading.
Vendor view: all topics for one vendor; identify where the vendor surfaces.
Vendor-in-market view: one vendor inside one defined market.
Vendor relationship view: pricing, contracting, support, renewal, and customer experience.
Absence view: where a vendor does not appear and which conversations they are missing.

content.value: Automation roadmap implied by the deck
